beats_top.query: how to get into a full class at Cornell waitlist
beats_top.why: The top results are single-department pages (Stats, ENGRC, CS) that each cover only their own courses; ours gives the registrar steps, the position-number warning, swap traps, per-department rules, a contact table and a backup plan in one flow, and the first paragraph answers the question.
